test_title: PYST 32: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

P- for a

Q- exercise daily

R- one must

S- good body
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Part R comes first** as it introduces the subject and action, "one must":

 
 
• "one must"
 
 
 
• **Part Q follows next** as it describes what one must do, "exercise daily":
 
 
• "exercise daily"
 
 
 
• **Part P is next** to introduce the purpose, "for a":
 
 
• "for a"
 
 
 
• **Part S completes the thought** with the goal, "good body":
 
 
• "good body"
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **RQPS**.

 

**Coherent sentence after rearrangement**:

"One must exercise daily for a good body."
